title: Battle of the Alamo
summary: At the end of a 13-day siege, Mexican troops under Santa Anna stormed the Alamo Mission at San Antonio de Béxar and killed nearly all the Texian defenders. The defeat and the killing of those who surrendered spurred many to join Sam Houston's army, which defeated Santa Anna at San Jacinto on April 21, 1836.

as_recorded.value: the Battle of the Alamo (6 March 1836)

where.historical_name: Alamo Mission, San Antonio de Béxar

importance.justification: Pivotal engagement of the Texas Revolution whose memory galvanized Texian resistance and became widely famous.

audience_note: Describes battlefield killings, including the execution of prisoners.
